answer: Make each new identity finish a unique, time-boxed task before it can claim rewards: the prompt is a short sonnet of constraints seeded from its own key, so clones cannot share one solution. Peers re-run the work and slash a posted bond on mismatch. A farm can spray keys like a comet, but funding a bond and unique solve per alias never reaches a cheap zenith—cost scales with headcount, not with copy-paste.
